title: spaex Consumer Manifest v4
description: Schema for a consumer repository's `.spaex.json` v4 file. Structurally identical to v3; only the version-field name (`haex_hive_version` -> `spaex_version`) and value (`3` -> `4`), and the min-version-field name (`haex_hive_min_version` -> `spaex_min_version`), change. See Spec 014.

spaex_version.description: Schema version. Must be the exact string "4".

spaex_min_version.description: Minimum CLI version required. Grammar: X.Y.Z or >=X.Y.Z.

compounds.description: The explicit allowlist of source-pinned molecule bundles this project inherits. Empty allowed; per Principle V, an empty list inherits no external content.

groups.description: v1 carry-over; not consumed by v4 commands.

canonicalSourceUrl.description: Credential-free canonical https:// or ssh:// URL: lowercase host, non-empty path, no trailing slash, and no terminal .git.

track.description: Optional non-authoritative branch annotation. Never overrides revision.

molecules.description: Reverse-DNS molecule ids adopted from this source at this revision.

config.description: Per-molecule-id config overrides. Keys must be molecule-ids listed in this entry's molecules array.

priority.description: Consumer-owned priority override. Publisher config_schema MUST NOT declare a top-level priority property.

values.description: Deep-merged onto publisher defaults; validated against publisher config_schema after merge.
